findings.description: When the target already exists, the function returns early without removing the temporary file in incoming/. Every duplicate upload leaves a full-size orphan file behind, so disk usage grows without bound for repeated puts of the same content.
findings.suggestion: Call incoming.unlink(missing_ok=True) before returning in the existing-target branch. Wrap the digest, exists and os.replace section in try/finally or try/except that cleans up the temp file on failure.
findings.title: Temp upload file leaked when blob already exists

findings.description: The cleanup guard only covers the write loop. If _path_for, mkdir or os.replace raises (permissions, disk error), the temp file stays in incoming/ with no cleanup.
findings.suggestion: Extend the cleanup to cover the finalize steps, or unlink the temp file in a finally block unless the replace succeeded.
findings.title: Temp file leaked if mkdir/replace fails
